address: DoubleTree by Hilton Harrogate Majestic Hotel and Spa, Ripon Road, Harrogate,HG1 2HU
bio: Built in 1889, DoubleTree by Hilton Harrogate Majestic Hotel & Spa sits in eight acres of landscaped gardens in the heart of Harrogate.  Experience culinary excellence with the Majestic Afternoon Tea, offering a diverse menu suitable for all appetites and occasions.  Enjoy a selection of fresh scones, sandwiches, and delectable sweets, accompanied by a range of Twinings teas or filter coffee. Elevate your experience by adding a glass of Prosecco, Champagne or a Gin & Tonic for that special occasion.  Elegantly styled with Edwardian flair, Carters Champagne Bar & Grill menu features local seasonal produce.  DoubleTree by Hilton Harrogate Majestic Hotel & Spa is located close to Harrogate Convention Centre, Royal Pump Room Museum and Harrogate train station.
